title: Practice: an architecture review against a rubric (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a sound design passes review with no findings
cases.says: A sound design passes review with no findings and is approved

cases.id: e1 a design without a feedback loop or a stage is rejected
cases.says: A missing feedback loop or a missing stage is a high finding

cases.id: e2 autonomy is flagged only when the path is known
cases.says: Autonomy is flagged only when the path is known

cases.id: e3 several agents need independent parts and no shared context
cases.says: A team needs independent parts and no shared context; one agent is exempt

cases.id: e4 an unapproved write is a finding only when an audit is needed
cases.says: An unapproved write is a finding only when an audit is needed

cases.id: e5 output that nobody validates is flagged
cases.says: Output without a validation step is flagged; an absent output stage is not flagged twice

cases.id: e6 findings are ordered by severity then rule and the verdict follows the worst
cases.says: The findings are ordered by severity and then rule, and the verdict follows the worst

cases.id: e7 the cheapest design that is not rejected wins and ties go by name
cases.says: The cheapest design that is not rejected wins, ties go by name, and none passing gives no name
